eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 International Conference on Electrical, Communication, and Computing Technologies (iCONECCT)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Power, Energy and Industry Applications; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: Madhav Institute of Technology; Madhya Pradesh Section; National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
eventDetail.scope: This conference will serve as a vibrant forum for presenting pioneering research, exploring the latest technological advancements, and discussing innovative solutions in the fields of electrical engineering, electronics, and computing technologies. iCONECCT-2027 aims to facilitate cross disciplinary collaboration and the exchange of ideas that will drive the future of these dynamic and interrelated fields.
